test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What significant milestone did Pixxel achieve with its 2025 space launch?

options.text: India’s first lunar lander by a startup
Launch of the first private satellite constellation from India
Construction of a domestic space observatory

solution:
The correct answer is __**Launch of the first private satellite constellation from India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pixxel**, a Bengaluru-based startup, achieved a significant milestone by launching the **first private satellite constellation from India**. This marked an important step in India's growing private space sector.
 
• The satellite constellation comprises a series of small yet powerful satellites designed to provide **high-resolution hyperspectral imaging capabilities**.
 
• The purpose of the constellation is to **monitor the Earth** for various applications like **climate monitoring, agricultural analysis, urban planning, and disaster management**.
 
• Pixxel’s 2025 space launch has placed India on the global map for **private space exploration and satellite technology**.
 
• The company is contributing to India’s thriving space economy by leveraging **innovative technology** and fostering collaboration with government organizations like the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• This achievement aligns with the Indian government’s push toward **privatizing the space sector** and encouraging startups to participate in space exploration and satellite technology.
 
• The satellite constellation enables **real-time data collection and analysis**, providing critical insights for industries across the globe.
 
• The launch demonstrates India’s capability to **compete in the global commercial satellite market** and showcases the growing potential of indigenous talent and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Pixxel:**

 
 
• Pixxel is a **space-tech startup** based in Bengaluru, India, founded in **2019**.
 
• The company focuses on building **hyperspectral imaging satellites** capable of capturing data across the electromagnetic spectrum.
 
• Pixxel aims to address challenges like **climate change, resource management, and disaster mitigation** using its satellite data.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Satellite Constellation:**
 
 
• The satellite constellation delivers **high-resolution images** that help in analyzing environmental changes and detecting early signs of natural disasters.
 
• It has applications in **agriculture** (e.g., crop health monitoring), **urban development**, and **defense**.
 
• Hyperspectral imaging allows for **greater detail and precision** compared to traditional imaging technologies.
 
 
 
• **India’s Space Privatization:**
 
 
• India’s space privatization efforts are led by the **Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Center (IN-SPACe)**, established in **2020**.
 
• The government encourages private players to collaborate with ISRO for **launch services, satellite development, and data analysis**.
 
• Pixxel’s achievement highlights the success of these initiatives and strengthens India’s position in the **global space economy**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Options:**
 
 
• **Launch of a reusable rocket:** While this is a significant milestone in space exploration, it is not related to Pixxel’s 2025 achievement.
 
• **India’s first lunar lander by a startup:** This is not relevant to Pixxel, as the company focuses on satellite technology rather than lunar exploration.
 
• **Construction of a domestic space observatory:** This is unrelated to Pixxel’s contribution, as their focus is on satellite constellations, not observatories.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Hyperspectral Imaging Technology:**

 
 
• Unlike traditional imaging, hyperspectral imaging captures data across **multiple wavelengths** of light.
 
• This technology is essential for applications like **precision agriculture, environmental monitoring, and mineral exploration**.
 
 
 
• **Government Support for Space Startups:**
 
 
• India’s **space privatization policies** encourage startups to participate in space research and satellite launches.
 
• Collaboration with ISRO has enabled startups like Pixxel to access **critical infrastructure and expertise**.
 
 
 
• **Impact on the Global Market:**
 
 
• With the successful launch of its satellite constellation, Pixxel positions India as a **key player** in the global space industry.
 
• The data generated from Pixxel’s satellites will be used by **governments, corporations, and research organizations** worldwide.
